items.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: there are others, Eddie Lang and Oscar Moore in the older crowd. So I mean by now there is a certain amount I’ve picked up enough to know who were the major influences

ctx.x: So when you go to approach a book, okay now I’m going to write about guitarists, how do you start something like that? Do you start doing your own research and look into what’s available to listen to, or do you visit an archive?

Well, yeah, I’m going to do all that. But I know I’m going to begin with Charlie Christian, and I’m going to go from Charlie Christian on to Wes Montgomery, and there are others, Eddie Lang and Oscar Moore in the older crowd. So I mean by now there’s a certain amount I’ve picked up enough to know who were the major influences, who were the major stylists, and who I’ll concentrate on and who comes from them and who listened to them. And then on to George Benson. And so I have some ideas. But I’m going to go and…
